items.summary: An open-source remote desktop built for babysitting coding agents: open your phone's browser and you see your whole dev machine. It watches Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider, Copilot CLI, opencode, Cursor Agent and Amp, and pings you when one is waiting on you, finishes, or crashes — and you can schedule a prompt to resume when a session limit resets at 2 AM. Both ends are open source (AGPL-3.0), sessions are end-to-end encrypted over WebRTC with a PIN before the first frame, and LAN works with no account. Install with npm install -g whipdesk, run it, scan the QR code.
items.title: WhipDesk: drive your whole dev machine from your phone's browser — auto-alerts when a coding agent stalls, finishes or crashes (Product Hunt, Nov 25; open source, AGPL-3.0)

items.summary: An open-source collaboration platform that joins the Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents running on your team's machines into a single shared session: teammates can join the same session, review diffs, approve commands, or take over the remote desktop, while an agent on one machine can call MCP tools hosted on another, operate its desktop, and move files over. Code and credentials stay on the machine doing the work; the desktop stream runs peer-to-peer over WebRTC (AV1, up to 60 fps). Client and server are both Apache-2.0.
items.title: DeskFleet: connect the coding agents on every team machine into one shared session — cross-machine MCP tools and a shared remote desktop (Product Hunt, Nov 25; open source, Apache-2.0)

items.summary: A browser-based coding agent from Leaning Technologies: the Gemma 4 model runs locally in the browser through Google's LiteRT-LM (WebGPU-accelerated), while file writes, terminal commands, npm installs and dev servers all execute inside BrowserPod, a tiny Linux microVM in the same tab. No install, no account, no API key; model weights download from Hugging Face once and stay cached in the browser. Still in beta, and open-weight models don't match frontier quality or reliability. Try it at pipod.browserpod.io.
items.title: PiPod: a coding agent that runs entirely in a browser tab — Gemma 4 on-device, code executed in a Wasm microVM (released Nov 24)
